x: Walker had moved ahead and was some twenty places in front of Dabbs, with Bill Bird, second claim to Bels., just ahead. David had moved ahead of Eric who was losing a little ground, whilst Clive Shippen and Eddie Short had maintained their positions.
Bill Bird, as is his wont, was soon setting the pace with Bob Norton at his shoulder, and at 3 laps a group of eight had detached itself from the field.
He had his first serious dabble at 3 miling during this time, and in the L.C.C.Championships finished 3rd behind Pat Newell and Bill Bird in a best ever 14:30.2 - a time he is not proud of.
